definition: Mathematics disorder is a type of learning disorder involving difficulties in mathematics. In older diagnostic approaches it was treated as a separate disorder, but DSM-5 places it within the broader category of specific learning disorder rather than as a distinct diagnosis.

reasons: The packet supports that mathematics disorder was formerly treated as a distinct learning-disorder entity and that DSM-5 folds it into the single specific learning disorder category, but it does not explicitly support the added definitional claim that it is a disorder “involving difficulties in mathematics.”

The packet does not explicitly state that “mathematics disorder” involves difficulties in mathematics; it only lists “mathematics disorder” as one type within specific learning disorders without defining its core symptom content in these terms.

The packet supports that DSM-5 integrates different LD types (including mathematics disorder) into a single specific learning disorder category, but it does not clearly support the specific phrasing that “older diagnostic approaches” treated it as a distinct disorder beyond the general reference to “former versions.”
